title: EVN Open practice · Level 1: Four requirements, five runs
brief: Practice for the EVN Open capstone (G12.4): never a capstone level, which your teacher witnesses on your own option's task. The course fixes one example set of approved requirements. R1 (headline): the whole robot in the green goal. R2 (safety): never touch a wall or a block, and never enter the red crossing. R3: the goal within 20 s. R4: square as the whole robot first fits in the goal (the run ends there, so square up before it): heading within 10 deg of east. A run that breaks R2 scores 0 and fails the level, whatever else it did; any other run scores 25 for each requirement it meets. A requirement is met over the level when it holds on at least 80 % of the runs (R2 on every run). Level 1: five runs from the start box (+-10 mm, +-1 deg). Pass: no run breaks R2, R1 is met, and at least three of the four are met (60 %). Par: 9 s.

score.run: if(touches > 0 | noGoEntries > 0, 0, 25 + if(reached, 25, 0) + if(reached & time <= tmax, 25, 0) + if(reached & abs(wrap180(endHeading)) <= square, 25, 0))

inTime.value: count(r in runs: r.reached & r.time <= tmax)

squareIn.value: count(r in runs: r.reached & abs(wrap180(r.endHeading)) <= square)

met.value: if(breaches == 0, 1, 0) + if(goal >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0) + if(inTime >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0) + if(squareIn >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0)
